queue.claim: COLMAP images.txt stores a world-to-camera quaternion (QW QX QY QZ) and translation (camera centre = -R^T t), and COLMAP's pixel convention puts the centre of the top-left pixel at (0.5, 0.5), versus (0, 0) in OpenCV. The face3d Camera.centered cx = width/2 matches COLMAP.
queue.query: COLMAP output format images.txt QW QX QY QZ world to camera coordinate convention pixel center 0.5

queue.claim: In Metashape camera XML, cx and cy are offsets from the image centre, P1/P2 are swapped relative to OpenCV p1/p2, and the per-camera transform maps camera to chunk, followed by a separate chunk transform.
queue.query: Agisoft Metashape camera calibration model cx cy offset from image center P1 P2 convert to OpenCV

queue.claim: Typical surface accuracy versus a reference scan: single DSLR with a live sitter 0.5–2 mm in the central face (2–5 mm at the periphery); smartphone stills 1–3 mm; TrueDepth 0.5–2 mm; clinical 3dMD/Vectra-class systems about 0.2–0.5 mm.
queue.query: smartphone photogrammetry facial 3D scan accuracy compared with 3dMD mean surface deviation mm
